units.text: This is the **Summer 2023 catalog, recovered from the Internet Archive** — a representative slate, not the live 2026 list, because HGCS now hides camp names and prices behind the Brushfire platform. The live 2026 page confirms eight session windows consistent with the week-blocks below. **Prices are not published anywhere** (Brushfire-only), so no cost is shown. Grades are **rising** grades.
